reviewer: fresh_droid_holdout_prepare, independent of architecture renderer author
scope: Read-only review of the final Figure 2 architecture candidate and caption against actual spatial transport model code; no training, inference, benchmark evaluation, model weights, results or canonical figure edits by reviewer.

per_dependency_review.interpretation: Three recorded support RGB images enter a frozen local DINOv2 encoder.
DINO final patch tokens are pooled to 4x4, then standardized by training-only channel statistics; these operations are stated in the caption.
All three standardized support grids feed the trainable spatial encoder.
Only two normalized observed action blocks enter the context transitions.
Patch means of encoded observed support, adjacent differences and past actions form context. Floating label repaired so it no longer attaches to the action path.
The same three encoded observed states feed FiLM at every forecast horizon.
A single past-only context supplies scale and shift; FiLM is trainable and applied after the pre-FiLM key source is saved.
Chronological past blocks are the first two inputs of the unidirectional action GRU.
The selected GRU endpoint only depends on supplied future action blocks through the current horizon.
Conditioned support is rearranged into a three-state temporal sequence independently per patch.
The two original past prefix states plus horizon h prefix endpoint condition the temporal predictor.
Last temporal output becomes H_h with shape 16x96; LeWM architecture is trained offline, not frozen pretrained predictor weights.
Linear query projection consumes H_h.
Linear key projection consumes E_0 saved before FiLM, fixed across horizons for the current observed support.
Query is the left operand of Q_h K_0^T / sqrt(96) + 4I.
Key transpose is the right operand; rows correspond to destination patches and columns to fixed observed source patches.
Softmax across source-patch columns yields nonnegative unit-sum rows.
Matrix product source is normalized last observation Z_0, not E_0, a predicted state, RGB or a world coordinate.
The learned row-stochastic matrix multiplies the fixed observed grid.
T_h @ Z_0 is a 16x384 normalized feature mixture.
Sigmoid gate consumes the same H_h alias and returns one scalar per patch.
Fixed Z_0 is multiplied by 1-g_h before the two-branch sum.
Mixed T_h Z_0 is multiplied by g_h before the same sum.
Dashed control edges apply complementary coefficients; gate values are not an added third feature term.
The complementary mixture reaches the final addition as one operand.
Output is a normalized feature prediction; flattening and inverse normalization are omitted and disclosed, with no RGB decoding.
The same H_h first passes LayerNorm and learned affine projection from 96 to 384, then the feature-coordinate correction is saturated.
Unit-scaled tanh acts after projection and is added to the complementary blend in standardized feature coordinates.

tensor_and_training_contract.Z0: 16x384 last observed DINO patch grid, in shared per-channel training-standardized coordinates; fixed through horizons, not a trainable or RGB source.
tensor_and_training_contract.E0: 16x96 last observed spatial encoding before FiLM. Its value is reused through horizons, but spatial encoder/key projection weights are trainable; fixed is not detached/frozen.
tensor_and_training_contract.Hh: 16x96 horizon-specific temporal state. Repeated named ports are aliases of the same tensor, as explicitly disclosed in the caption.
tensor_and_training_contract.context: 32-dimensional past-only context from two [patch-mean state, state difference, observed action] transitions; no future observation or future action enters context.
tensor_and_training_contract.FiLM: value * (1 + 0.1*tanh(scale(context))) + shift(context), applied to all three encoded observed states.
tensor_and_training_contract.action_prefix: Each a is a block of five native 7D commands (35D). The unidirectional GRU processes two past blocks followed by supplied future blocks; horizon h uses the original past prefix states and its own prefix endpoint, not subsequent commands.
tensor_and_training_contract.trainable: Spatial projection/attention, context, FiLM, action GRU, LeWM temporal predictor, query/key, gate and innovation projection train offline. Only DINOv2 model weights are frozen in this proposed arm; normalization statistics and identity buffer are fixed.
tensor_and_training_contract.normalization: Training-only channel mean/std are shared over all 16 patches; unbiased sample std is floored at 1e-5. Returned model features are inverse normalized, omitted from the figure and disclosed.
tensor_and_training_contract.residual_bound: Delta=tanh(LayerNorm+Linear96to384(Hh)) because registered bound=1. The bound is per normalized feature coordinate, not raw feature MSE, a geometric displacement bound, or a stability/performance guarantee.
tensor_and_training_contract.mixture_bound: M=(1-g)I+gT remains row-stochastic. Per channel, the mixture is between the minimum and maximum observed source value; adding Delta yields |Zhat_jc| <= max_k|Z0_kc|+1 in standardized coordinates.
tensor_and_training_contract.initialization_limit: Identity bias 4I and initial gate sigmoid(-3) bias mixing toward the anchor but do not make initialization exactly identity. The figure makes no exact identity initialization claim.
tensor_and_training_contract.no_future_leakage: Only three observed support frames and causal supplied command prefixes enter forecasting. Query RGB is used for training loss/evaluation only, not as an input in the depicted inference path.

visual_review.result: Final color and grayscale preserve the two complementary feature branches, dashed gate controls, distinct post-projection bound and tensor aliases. No observed broken connector, ambiguous branch, clipping or text overlap remains. Official standalone ICLR page also inspected.
visual_review.resolved_issue: Initial floating patch mean label looked attached to the past-action branch. Author removed that label, retained the spatial-encoding branch, and preserved exact patch-mean wording in caption.
visual_review.remaining_integration_check: Root must inspect the assembled manuscript page; this receipt reviews the standalone final figure and official standalone template proof, not later manuscript placement.

schematic_limits: Feature colors, displayed 16x16 mixing matrix, four gate bars and three projected coordinates are illustrative, not measured learned values.
These are normalized latent feature mixtures, not RGB synthesis, optical flow, physical robot correspondences or evidence of closed-loop control.
Three source photographs are unchanged observed DROID frames; no generated evidence images or future target image inputs.
